entries.649a871e66d7f35f: The company provides “GVA Corporate Registration,” which makes it easy to prepare documents for applying for changes to commercial registration; “GVA Registry Acquisition,” which makes it easy to request certificates such as a full certificate of corporate history; and “GVA Trademark Registration,” which makes it easy to prepare trademark application documents. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥667 million.
entries.7dd4c75075a7acbb: A legal tech company that provides the legal SaaS "OLGA" and an online registration support service.
entries.ab76733226289950: The company develops in-house and provides “OLGA,” a legal automation product, as a SaaS-type cloud service. “OLGA” consists of four modules, “AI legal assistant,” “legal data platform,” “AI contract review” and “contract management,” and can also be introduced module by module. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥816 million.
entries.eb19f0527fa1b30f: This is a single segment of "LegalTech", which combines law and IT technology. It provides two service groups: the LegalTech SaaS business, which advances DX of legal affairs work, and the registration business, which supports registration procedures online. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,483 million.
